in_sanskrit.name: करुणेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: करुण (karuṇa) - compassion एश (eśa) - he, that, this, this one Therefore, Karunesh means 'The one who bestows compassion'

in_hindi.name: करुणेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: करुण (karuṇa) - compassion पूर्ण (pūrṇa) - full, complete Therefore, Karunesh in Hindi means 'Full of compassion'

in_tamil.name: கருணேஷ
in_tamil.meaning: கருணம் (karuṇam) - compassion இஷ் (iṟṟu) - he, this, that Therefore, Karunesh in Tamil means 'He who is full of compassion'

in_telugu.name: కరుణేశ
in_telugu.meaning: కరుణ (karuṇa) - compassion ఈష (iśa) - he, this, that Therefore, Karunesh in Telugu means 'He who is full of compassion'

in_marathi.name: Karunesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karunesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Karunesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'karuna' meaning compassion, and 'ish' meaning Lord. The name is bestowed upon a child to instill in them the qualities of compassion and mercy.
